description: Use Baixiao AI knowledge, document, research, and productivity tools.

auth.label: MCP Key
auth.description: The key sent to Baixiao MCP as an Authorization bearer token. Sign in and generate a key at https://chat.know-pa.cn/settings/mcp.

actions.name: advanced_search
actions.description: Search across Baixiao's databases by title, author, journal, publisher, publication period, document type, and language.

author.description: An exact author name, matched case-insensitively where supported.

journal.description: An exact journal name, matched case-insensitively where supported.

publisher.description: An exact publisher name, matched case-insensitively where supported.

year_from.description: The earliest publication year to include.

year_to.description: The latest publication year to include.

limit.description: The maximum number of works to return. Defaults to 20.

inputSchema.description: Optional fields combined to narrow an academic search.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Baixiao MCP tool with JSON arguments after inspecting its live schema and behavior annotations with list_tools.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Baixiao MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: citation_graph
actions.description: Traverse the works that cite a paper or the references cited by that paper for literature-review expansion.

paper_id.description: A DOI or the external_id returned by a previous Baixiao search.

direction.description: The citation-graph direction. Defaults to cited_by.

limit.description: The maximum number of related works to return. Defaults to 20.

inputSchema.description: A paper identifier and citation-graph direction.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: corpus_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's curated humanities and social-science corpus, especially for Chinese-language scholarship and Chinese authors.

query.description: The literature or research question to search for.

collection_ids.description: Baixiao collection IDs used to restrict the search.

page_size.description: The maximum number of documents to return. Defaults to 15.

inputSchema.description: A query and optional Baixiao corpus filters.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: external_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's international academic coverage for English-language papers and citable metadata.

limit.description: The maximum number of papers to return. Defaults to 15.

from_year.description: The earliest publication year to include.

to_year.description: The latest publication year to include.

inputSchema.description: A query, result limit, and optional publication-year range.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: fetch_metadata
actions.description: Complete a partial or messy citation into clean publication metadata and return alternate matches.

query.description: The partial citation, rough title, or author-year-title text.

year.description: The publication year used to disambiguate matches.

top.description: The maximum number of candidate matches to return. Defaults to 5.

inputSchema.description: A partial citation and optional disambiguation settings.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: fetch_metadata_batch
actions.description: Complete multiple partial references into clean publication metadata in one request.

items.description: A partial citation, rough title, or author-year-title string.

max_concurrency.description: The maximum number of parallel lookups performed by Baixiao. Defaults to 8.

inputSchema.description: Partial references and an optional concurrency limit.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: find_reviewers
actions.description: Suggest potential peer reviewers by ranking authors of topic-matching works while excluding manuscript authors when requested.

keywords.description: Topic keywords used to rank relevant records.

exclude_authors.description: Manuscript authors to exclude from reviewer suggestions.

top.description: The maximum number of reviewers to return. Defaults to 15.

rounds.description: The number of deterministic keyword-expansion rounds. Defaults to 2.

inputSchema.description: Manuscript keywords, optional author exclusions, and ranking options.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: get_pdf
actions.description: Get a short-lived PDF download link for an available document in Baixiao's public corpus; a successful lookup consumes the connected account's credits.

identifier.description: The external_id returned by a Baixiao corpus or advanced search result.

inputSchema.description: A Baixiao corpus document to download.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: grants_award_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's awarded research projects by topic, investigator, institution, geography, funder, program, discipline, outcome, or year.

query.description: Topic terms found in project titles or descriptions.

person.description: The principal investigator or project leader.

region.description: A mainland China region associated with the investigator.

funder.description: A funding-body name or Baixiao funder ID.

program.description: The funding program or project category.

year_from.description: The earliest award year to include.

year_to.description: The latest award year to include.

sources.description: The geographic data sources to search.

limit.description: The maximum number of project records to return. Defaults to 10.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for awarded research projects.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: grants_cfp_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's research funding calls by topic, geography, funder, status, deadline, year, and minimum award amount.

query.description: Topic terms without generic funding or application words.

region.description: A mainland China province or national for nationwide calls.

funder.description: A funding-body name or Baixiao funder ID.

deadline_from.description: The earliest application deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format.

deadline_to.description: The latest application deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format.

year_from.description: The earliest notice publication year to include.

year_to.description: The latest notice publication year to include.

amount_min.description: The minimum parsed single-project award amount in yuan.

sources.description: The geographic data sources to search.

limit.description: The maximum number of calls to return. Defaults to 10.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for research funding calls.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: hk_grants_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's Hong Kong RGC funded-project collection by free text and award period.

query.description: A short free-text query for a topic, principal investigator, institution, or funding scheme.

year_from.description: The earliest award year to include.

year_to.description: The latest award year to include.

limit.description: The maximum number of projects to return, up to 50. Defaults to 5.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for Hong Kong research grants.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: journal_fit
actions.description: Recommend publication venues for a manuscript by ranking journals with topic-matching works in Baixiao's databases.

keywords.description: Topic keywords used to rank relevant records.

language.description: The result language, or omit it for automatic detection.

top.description: The maximum number of journals to return. Defaults to 10.

rounds.description: The number of deterministic keyword-expansion rounds. Defaults to 2.

inputSchema.description: Manuscript keywords and ranking options.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: list_my_kbs
actions.description: List the connected user's available Baixiao knowledge bases and their collection IDs for later searches.

inputSchema.description: No input is required.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Baixiao literature, knowledge-base, policy, and research-funding MCP tools with their live input schemas and behavior annotations.

inputSchema.description: No input is required.

name.description: The exact Baixiao MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Baixiao MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside Baixiao.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Baixiao for the tool.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Baixiao MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected Baixiao MCP service.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the Baixiao MCP service.

outputSchema.description: The current Baixiao MCP tool catalog.

actions.name: my_kb_search
actions.description: Search the connected user's personal, team, teaching, and subscribed Baixiao knowledge bases.

query.description: The query to search across the connected user's knowledge bases.

collection_ids.description: Baixiao collection IDs used to restrict the search.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 15.

inputSchema.description: A query and optional personal knowledge-base filters.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: policy_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's central and local Chinese government policy collection by text, issuer, author, period, or document type.

query.description: A free-text policy topic or phrase.

year_from.description: The earliest publication year to include.

year_to.description: The latest publication year to include.

doc_type.description: The policy document type to include.

limit.description: The maximum number of policies to return. Defaults to 15.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for Chinese government policy documents.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: verify_reference
actions.description: Look up one reference across Baixiao's databases and report its match status, best candidate, confidence, and metadata warnings.

title.description: The title of the work to verify.

journal.description: The expected journal or publication venue.

doi.description: The expected DOI, with or without the DOI prefix.

language.description: The result language, or omit it for automatic detection.

is_book.description: Whether the reference is a book.

inputSchema.description: Known metadata for one reference.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: verify_references
actions.description: Batch-check a bibliography across Baixiao's databases and return per-reference match results with aggregate counts.

title.description: The work title, recommended when no DOI is available.

doi.description: The DOI, with or without the DOI prefix.

language.description: The result language, or omit it for automatic detection.

is_book.description: Whether the reference is a book.

items.description: A reference to verify against Baixiao's databases.

max_concurrency.description: The maximum number of parallel lookups performed by Baixiao. Defaults to 8.

inputSchema.description: A bibliography and optional concurrency limit.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.

actions.name: xi_thought_search
actions.description: Search Baixiao's New Thought collection of key theoretical and ideological texts by topic, author, period, or document type.

year_from.description: The earliest publication year to include.

year_to.description: The latest publication year to include.

limit.description: The maximum number of texts to return. Defaults to 15.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for theoretical and ideological texts.

outputSchema.description: The normalized structured result returned by the Baixiao MCP tool.
